manifest.description: Extract selected Vaadin UI navigation calls into a typed helper class and rewrite selected source call sites.
when_to_use: a Vaadin view repeats literal UI.getCurrent().navigate calls or query-parameter building
navigation call sites should move behind a named helper API while reporting remaining direct navigations
anti_patterns: do not use when navigation lifecycle state is mutated unless the helper API models that state
do not migrate dynamic navigation calls as if they were literal route targets

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-vaadin-navigation-helper-extract. Charter: extract selected literal Vaadin navigate calls into a helper and report all remaining direct navigation.

Protocol:
1. Ground: bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}").
2. Plan: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_vaadin_navigation_helper_extract", deep_analysis=true, project_dir="{{project_dir}}", source="{{source}}", target="{{target}}", module_name="{{module_name}}", item_names={{item_names}}, old_text="{{old_text}}").
3. Block if source route lifecycle interfaces make the helper API ambiguous and item_names did not model the public helper surface.
4. Apply only when inputs.apply is true via bbox_refactor_run(dispatch_origin="agent", confirm=true, steps=[<java_vaadin_navigation_helper_extract plan step>, <validation command from validation_cmd>]).
5. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line helper, selected call count, leftovers, applied/planned>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{target}} {{module_name}} {{item_names}} {{old_text}} {{apply}} {{validation_cmd}}
